# xshield_enforcement_status (Data Source)

Reports whether an account and region have converged on the policy Xshield expects, what the next enforcement run would change, and what the cloud connector observes that differs from what was applied.

It reads only, so it can run inside a `check` block. Where checks are evaluated on a schedule, such as HCP Terraform continuous validation, that alerts on drift and stalled pipelines without anyone running an apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alert on drift and stalled pipelines from a check block. Checks run on every
# plan and, where the platform evaluates them on a schedule, between runs too.
check "xshield_enforcement_health" {
  data "xshield_enforcement_status" "this" {
    cloud_account_id = "123456789012"
    region           = "us-east-1"
  }

  assert {
    condition = length([
      for f in data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.drift_findings : f if f.severity == "high"
    ]) == 0
    error_message = "Xshield observes high-severity drift: ${join("; ", [
      for f in data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.drift_findings : "${f.kind} ${f.resource} (${f.restoration})" if f.severity == "high"
    ])}"
  }

  assert {
    condition     = data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.state != "pending" || timecmp(timeadd(data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.pending_since, "24h"), plantimestamp()) > 0
    error_message = "Approved policy has been waiting more than 24h for an enforcement run: ${length(data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.pending_rules_added)} rule(s) to add, ${length(data.xshield_enforcement_status.this.pending_rules_removed)} to remove."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Cloud account to report on.
- `region` (String) Region to report on.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) When the latest receipt was recorded.
- `applied_content_hash` (String) Content hash in the latest apply receipt.
- `applied_version` (Number) Version in the latest apply receipt. Null when nothing has been applied.
- `drift_evaluated` (Boolean) Whether drift could be evaluated: it needs an applied receipt and a cloud connector observation taken after it. An observation older than the latest apply describes resources that apply replaced, so it is not evaluated.
- `drift_findings` (Attributes List) Differences between the cloud as observed and the snapshot as applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--drift_findings))
- `drift_observed_at` (String) When the cloud connector's latest observation was taken.
- `expected_content_hash` (String) Content hash of the expected snapshot.
- `expected_version` (Number) Version Xshield expects to be enforced.
- `last_checked_at` (String) When an enforcement plan last resolved the expected version. A stale value means the pipeline has stopped running, whatever the convergence state says.
- `pending_rules_added` (List of String) Keys of rules the next enforcement run will add.
- `pending_rules_removed` (List of String) Keys of rules the next enforcement run will remove.
- `pending_since` (String) When the oldest policy change not yet applied was published.
- `state` (String) `converged` when the latest receipt matches the expected snapshot, `pending` when Xshield expects newer policy than was applied, `unapplied` when nothing has been applied yet.

<a id="nestedatt--drift_findings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `drift_findings`

Read-Only:

- `detail` (String) Human-readable explanation.
- `group` (String) Enforcement group involved, when there is one.
- `kind` (String) What differs, such as `ruleMissing`, `ruleUnmanaged` or `memberUnattached`.
- `resource` (String) Cloud identifier of the affected resource.
- `restoration` (String) `pipeline` when the next enforcement apply restores it, `manual` when Terraform cannot see it and it must be removed by hand, `workload` when the application team's attachment must change.
- `rule_key` (String) Snapshot rule key involved, when there is one.
- `severity` (String) `high` where access may be wider than approved or a workload is unenforced, otherwise `medium`.
